name: – Andreas Schieder – After § 33 – Am 1
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Albania
part_text: 33a. Underlines that, according to Eurostat, Albania’s GDP per capita represented less than one sixth of the EU average in 2024, placing Albania last among the candidate countries in terms of GDP per capita; underlines that the accession of a country presenting such a development gap would generate considerable financial transfers at the expense of Member States;
